Subject: Re: Extracting attachments, filenames with spaces 

This was probably obvious to most other people, but I figured out how 
to get exmh to open remote files when the filenames have spaces. In my 
mailcap, I have e.g.

application/msword; ooffice "%s"

instead of 

application/msword; ooffice %s
